summary: SMJ International Holdings Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted foreign private issuer listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting held September 15, 2026 in Singapore. Shareholders passed a special resolution adopting a Second Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association and an ordinary resolution authorizing the board to effect filings. Changes remove director vacation and Class B holder death as automatic conversion triggers, lower the written-resolution threshold to two-thirds, and delete show-of-hands voting. Votes were 131,441,442 for and 15,076 against. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation.
